dialogue.origin: こんにちわ。
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: おはようございますよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good morning. Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: I look forward to our session as well.

dialogue.origin: 少し早いですが、準備が出来ましたら、はじめたいと・・大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: It's a little early, but if you're ready, I'd like to begin... Is that okay?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫ですよ！
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine!

dialogue.origin: 相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: I'm the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 妹がゆるせないのです
dialogue.content: I can't forgive my younger sister.

dialogue.origin: 妹さんが・・許せないとは、何か事情がおありなんですね・・
dialogue.content: Your younger sister... To say you can't forgive her, there must be a reason for that...

dialogue.origin: 聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: Would you be willing to tell me about it?

dialogue.origin: はい、たくさんのことがありまして、ずっと絶縁をしているのです
dialogue.content: Yes, a lot has happened, and we've been estranged for a long time.

dialogue.origin: ？そうなんですね・・それは苦しいかと思われますが、想いのほどを聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: I see... That must be painful. Could you tell me more about your feelings?

dialogue.origin: ↑初めの？は間違いです。失礼いたしました。
dialogue.content: The initial "?" was a mistake. My apologies.

dialogue.origin: 妹は、母を入所させたくないのです
dialogue.content: My sister doesn't want our mother to be placed in a care facility.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、
dialogue.content: But…

dialogue.origin: 私が介護をしていたのですが、恋人が海外赴任が決まり、しせつに母を入所させて結婚することにしました
dialogue.content: I had been caring for my mother, but my partner was assigned overseas, so I decided to place my mother in a facility and get married.

dialogue.origin: でも、
dialogue.content: But…

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 妹は、大反対をして
dialogue.content: My sister strongly opposed it,

dialogue.origin: 私の婚約者やその家族に迫り、婚約を破棄されました
dialogue.content: and she pressured my fiancé and his family, leading to the engagement being broken off.

dialogue.origin: 破断です
dialogue.content: It was called off.

dialogue.origin: 破談
dialogue.content: Broken off.

dialogue.origin: ええ、婚約を破棄されたんですか？とてもそれは苦しくて許せないってきもちになられてもおかしくないですよね・・
dialogue.content: Oh, your engagement was broken off? It's completely understandable that you would feel so much pain and find it unforgivable...

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 一生けん命介護もされていて、
dialogue.content: And you were trying so hard to care for your mother,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 婚約者との幸せも目前で
dialogue.content: And your happiness with your fiancé was right there in front of you.

dialogue.origin: それに
dialogue.content: On top of that,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私が介護していたときは、妹は、介護を手伝わなかったのです
dialogue.content: When I was taking care of her, my sister didn't help with the caregiving at all.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。なおさら理不尽だとおもってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must make it feel all the more unfair.

dialogue.origin: はい、思っているのです
dialogue.content: Yes, it does.

dialogue.origin: 腹が立ちます
dialogue.content: I'm so angry.

dialogue.origin: はい、腹立たしいと思っても無理はないですよね。婚約者さんとこれから幸せになりたいと思ったがゆえの、お母さんの入所だったのではないかと思うので
dialogue.content: Yes, it's not surprising you feel angry. I imagine you decided to place your mother in a facility because you wanted to build a happy future with your fiancé.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 妹さんとはお母さんの入所の件ではどのような話し合いが出来たのでしょう
dialogue.content: What kind of discussions were you able to have with your sister about placing your mother in the facility?

dialogue.origin: 妹は、私に、親不孝者！と罵倒しました激しく起こりました
dialogue.content: My sister berated me, calling me an unfilial daughter! She got extremely angry.

dialogue.origin: 怒りました
dialogue.content: Angry.

dialogue.origin: 激しく罵倒されたんですね。怒ってののしられて、とても悔しかったですよね。がまんされたのではないでしょうか・・
dialogue.content: She berated you so harshly. Being yelled at and insulted like that must have been incredibly frustrating. I imagine you had to hold a lot back...

dialogue.origin: そうですね、
dialogue.content: Yes, I did.

dialogue.origin: お母さんだけの事ではなく婚約者やその家族にも、接触されて、
dialogue.content: And it wasn’t just about your mother—she even contacted your fiancé and his family,

dialogue.origin: 破談になるようになってしまったんですよね
dialogue.content: which led to the engagement being broken off, right?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: その後、心がやみました
dialogue.content: After that, I was emotionally devastated.

dialogue.origin: はい。とてもとても聞いていて胸が締め付けられる気持ち、伝わります。やるせない気持ち、悔しい気持ち、さまざまですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes. Hearing this, I can feel how heart-wrenching it must have been. I can sense your feelings of helplessness, frustration, and so many other emotions.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's exactly it.

dialogue.origin: でも、
dialogue.content: But…

dialogue.origin: 怒りをぶつけて下さいね。はい。
dialogue.content: Please, feel free to vent your anger here. Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: いえ。本当にお辛いかと感じています。
dialogue.content: Of course. I can only imagine how painful this has been for you.

dialogue.origin: 先日、妹が、余命宣告を受けました
dialogue.content: The other day, my sister was told she doesn't have long to live.

dialogue.origin: ええ！それは・・なんとも・・お姉さんにとっては・・
dialogue.content: Oh! That must be... I can't imagine... for you, as her older sister...

dialogue.origin: んー、いろいろと悩んでいるのですね
dialogue.content: Mmm, I'm struggling with a lot of conflicting feelings.

dialogue.origin: それは色々どころか・・どこに気持ちをおさめたらいいかですね・・。妹さんの余命は何年かきかせてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: It’s more than just 'a lot'… It’s hard to know where to put your feelings. May I ask how long the doctors have given your sister?

dialogue.origin: あと半年です
dialogue.content: She has six months left.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・もう、それは、、、何から話そうかとなっておりますが、、相談者さんの今の率直なお気持ちはいかがですか？
dialogue.content: I see... Well, that's... I'm a bit at a loss for where to begin, but... what are your honest feelings right now?

dialogue.origin: 7年間ずっと絶縁で、見舞いに1度も行ったことがないのです。妹とは、1回も会っていません。どう思われるかも気になる・親戚に、
dialogue.content: We've been estranged for seven years, and I haven't visited her even once. I haven't seen my sister at all. I'm also worried about what our relatives will think.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。妹さん七年間も病気とたたかっておられたんですね・・お姉さんはそれをしっかり今受け止めようとされておられる。
dialogue.content: I see. So your sister has been battling an illness for seven years... And you are now trying to come to terms with this.

dialogue.origin: 違うんです
dialogue.content: That's not it.

dialogue.origin: 7年間絶縁だったのは、結婚を破談にされた以降からです。
dialogue.content: We’ve been estranged for the seven years since my engagement was broken off.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたね・・失礼しました。
dialogue.content: That's right... I apologize for my misunderstanding.

dialogue.origin: うけとめようとも、思っていません
dialogue.content: I'm not even trying to come to terms with it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・受け止められないほど、相談者さんの今が苦しいのですよね
dialogue.content: I see... You're in too much pain right now to even be able to process it.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんです、悔しいし、悲しいしで
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s right. I’m frustrated and sad,

dialogue.origin: 腹も立っていて
dialogue.content: and I'm angry.

dialogue.origin: ええ、破談にされた悲しみは癒えないですものね。余命半年と聞いても、色々複雑にからみあった口惜しさ、悲しさ、いら立ちがおさまらないんですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, the sorrow from your engagement being broken off hasn't healed, has it? Even hearing she only has six months left, the complex tangle of resentment, sadness, and irritation doesn't just go away, does it?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.origin: ここまで整理してもいいですか？
dialogue.content: May I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母さんの介護をひとりでとても頑張っておられました。婚約者という存在も出来、簡単な気持ちで入所させたわけではないと感じています
dialogue.content: You were trying so hard, taking care of your mother all by yourself. You had a fiancé, and I feel that the decision to put her in a care facility was not one you made lightly.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ただ何も介護していなかった妹さんが怒って罵倒し、親不孝だとののしり、反対されました。
dialogue.content: However, your sister, who hadn't helped with the caregiving at all, got angry, berated you, called you an unfilial daughter, and opposed your decision.

dialogue.origin: それだけでも母を入所させたという事実はそうとうなショックがあったかと。なのに、
dialogue.content: Just that alone must have been a huge shock after placing your mother in a facility. And on top of that,

dialogue.origin: 幸せになりたい婚約者との関係まで破談させられ、怒り心頭ですよね。妹さんとは以降七年間絶縁。
dialogue.content: she even destroyed your relationship with the fiancé you wanted to be happy with. You must have been furious. You've been estranged from your sister for the seven years since.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 許せない気持ちが今もなお消えずに、苦しんでおられる。
dialogue.content: The feeling of being unable to forgive her hasn't gone away, and you're still suffering.

dialogue.origin: 妹さんがガンと分かって余命半年となった今もなお、怒りをどこにぶつけたらいいのか・・
dialogue.content: And even now, knowing your sister has cancer and only six months to live, you don't know what to do with your anger...

dialogue.origin: 本当によくここまで頑張ってこられました
dialogue.content: You've truly done so well to endure all this.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 妹に、最後まで会わないのは、親戚にどう思われるか気になります
dialogue.content: I'm worried about what my relatives will think if I don't see my sister before the end.

dialogue.origin: 妹に会わないで、公開しないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: If I don’t see my sister, will I regret it?

dialogue.origin: 後悔です
dialogue.content: I mean, regret.

dialogue.origin: 絶縁という形をとることで怒りをぶつけられたように思えます。くやしかったですよね。でもふと親戚にどう思われるか、後悔しないかという気持ちがでてきたんですね・・
dialogue.content: It seems that being estranged was your way of directing your anger. It must have been so frustrating. But now, thoughts about what your relatives will think, and whether you'll have regrets, have started to surface...

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 妹さんにたいしてではなく、親戚への思われ方というかんじでしょうか・・
dialogue.content: Is it less about your sister and more about how you are perceived by your relatives...?

dialogue.origin: 少しお聞きしていいですか昔はどんな姉妹でしたか？
dialogue.content: May I ask you something? What was your relationship like as sisters when you were younger?

dialogue.origin: 妹への気持ちと、自分が後悔しないかという気持ちと、外から見てて、変に思われないかです
dialogue.content: It’s my feelings toward my sister, whether I will have regrets, and how it will look from the outside—whether people will think I'm strange.

dialogue.origin: はい色々複雑に絡み合っていますよね
dialogue.content: Yes, there are many complex feelings intertwined, aren't there?

dialogue.origin: 普通の姉妹だったと思います
dialogue.content: I think we were normal sisters.

dialogue.origin: 楽しい事は思い出せますか？
dialogue.content: Can you recall any happy memories?

dialogue.origin: 海で、一緒にスイカを食べたことです
dialogue.content: Eating watermelon together at the beach.

dialogue.origin: 美味しかったですよね。絶縁以外に喧嘩した事は思い出したくないですか？
dialogue.content: That must have been delicious. Besides this estrangement, would you rather not recall other times you fought?

dialogue.origin: 子供の頃とか・・
dialogue.content: Like when you were children…

dialogue.origin: 喧嘩はたくさんしたと思いますでも、思い出すのは嫌です
dialogue.content: I think we fought a lot, but I don’t want to remember them.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、失礼しました
dialogue.content: I see. Please forgive me for asking.

dialogue.origin: 提案なのですが、良い思い出を一つでました。
dialogue.content: If I may make a suggestion... one good memory did come up.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Please, go ahead.

dialogue.origin: 他にも忘れてしまった楽しかった思い出あるとは思います。それでも、妹さんの顔を見るのすら拒絶してしまうようならば、親戚がどう思うかは先ず関係ないと思います。ご自分が苦しいのですから。ただ
dialogue.content: I'm sure there are other happy memories that you've forgotten. Still, if you feel such a strong rejection that you can't even look at your sister's face, then I think what your relatives think is not the primary concern right now. Because you are the one who is suffering. However,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: この世に姉妹として生まれてきたことには何か意味があったのではないかと、考え方を変換できたら、相談者さんがされてきた悔しさもきっと他の形で生かされはしないかと・・すみません。上手く言えませんね
dialogue.content: if you could perhaps shift your perspective to think that there might have been some meaning in being born as sisters in this world, then maybe the frustration you've endured could be channeled into another form... I'm sorry. I'm not expressing this very well.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: すごく、悔しい思いをされてきて、抱えて超えてきて、今、妹さんこと、
dialogue.content: You've gone through so much frustration, carried it, and overcome it, and now, regarding your sister,

dialogue.origin: 、きにかけてここにいらした。もっとお話しがしたいです。が、時間に・・
dialogue.content: ...you're concerned enough to come here. I would like to talk more, but our time...

dialogue.origin: 妹さんには時間がないのですものね・・
dialogue.content: Your sister doesn't have much time, does she...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 怒ったままでも、一緒にご飯を食べてきた姉妹、さようならだけでも伝えて差し上げてほしいと、個人の考えで申し訳ありません。
dialogue.content: Even if you are still angry, you are sisters who have eaten meals together. I hope you might be able to at least say goodbye. I'm sorry, this is just my personal opinion.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですねありがとうございます。だんだん妹に会ったほうがよいと思い始めました
dialogue.content: Yes, I think you're right. Thank you. I'm gradually starting to think that I should see my sister.

dialogue.origin: そうですか？妹さんの分も生きて一杯意味を見つけてあげれたら・・時間になりました、
dialogue.content: Is that so? If you could live for your sister as well and find a wealth of meaning in it... Our time is up.

dialogue.origin: 無理せず頑張って下さいね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Please take care of yourself, and don't push yourself too hard. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 終了ボタンをおしますね、
dialogue.content: I'll press the end session button now.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you.

topic.sub: 妹との絶縁とその影響
